summary: Two queue items in NewHireBenefitsPosting (DevCon26) failed with BusinessException reason 'API_NOT_PUBLIC: '. Both items have status=Failed, processingExceptionType=BusinessException, error.code=User.QueueItemBusinessException. The processing time on each item is ~1-2 seconds, with logs showing Performer Init completed (assets loaded) and then the workflow immediately threw BusinessRuleException 'API_NOT_PUBLIC' from Framework/Process.xaml. The very first C-step in the documented pipeline is C-03 IdentityAssertion which calls GET /api/employees/me — consistent with the failure occurring before any other step ran (LinesPosted=0, EnrollmentId empty, ConfirmationNumber empty in TXN_LOG). Successful items continued processing through ~2026-05-14T08:12 (LinesPosted normally), and the most recent failure is at 09:22 same day. The earlier failure (2026-05-11T11:55) used the same exception code and is also marked reviewStatus=Retried, suggesting the operator already attempted a retry on the older one.

category_breakdown.notes: All failed items share the identical exception reason string 'API_NOT_PUBLIC: ' (trailing colon-space, empty detail). Per CLAUDE.md, the consumer uses BenefitConnect REST endpoints (/api/employees/me, /api/dependents, /api/beneficiaries, /api/enrollments/current, /api/plans/select, /api/enroll/draft, /api/enroll, /api/onboarding/pending/{id}/approve) with header X-API-Key from the ACB.BenefitConnect.ApiKey asset. CLAUDE.md explicitly calls out '403 API_NOT_PUBLIC' as a tenant-policy-revoke signal and lists it as the trigger to swap a C-step from API to UI Automation. Job logs show Init completed (assets loaded successfully) and the BusinessRuleException was thrown from Framework/Process.xaml very early in the transaction (1.4s total runtime), suggesting the failure is at or near C-03 GET /api/employees/me — the first call in the pipeline.

successful_items_compared.input_pattern_observation: Successful items use the same SpecificContent shape (TransactionId, EmployeeId, Username, HireDate, PlanYear, IntakeFormRef, ElectionsJson, DiscoveredAt, EnqueuedAt). No structural difference between successful and failed items' SpecificContent — both failed items use legitimate plan IDs from the documented catalog (MED-PPO, MED-HMO, DEN-BASIC, VIS-BASIC, STD, LTD, FSA-HC, COMMUTER, 401K). Failure is not driven by input-data shape; it appears to be a platform/API-side condition consistent across both items.

job_evidence.interpretation: Init step completed (all 4 assets loaded), TXN_LOG was emitted with LinesPosted=0, EnrollmentId blank, ConfirmationNumber blank — meaning no C-07 election post, no C-09 enrollment, no C-10 confirmation occurred. The failure happened at or before the C-07 stage and almost certainly at C-03 IdentityAssertion (the first API call). The classification path in Framework/HttpGet.xaml/HttpPost.xaml is designed to translate 403 into out_ErrorCode = 'API_NOT_PUBLIC' per CLAUDE.md, and Framework/Process.xaml then routes outcomeCode=BUSINESS_EXCEPTION through a BusinessRuleException throw — exactly the stack we see.

Both items share identical exception code so the bundle from the most recent failure is sufficient for playbook matching.
